summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Hamadryad nymphs Atlantia and Phoebe — bride of Alces son of Egyptus when the ten Arabian-born sons married the Hamadryad maidens at Argos; distinct from Glauce daughter of Creon of Corinth, wife of Jason.

story.text: Apollodorus pairs Alces with Glauce among the ten sons of Egyptus begotten on an Arabian woman and the ten daughters of Danaus begotten on Hamadryad nymphs. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom.
